'''BR:''' Rin Itoshi#CH273 |checkboxAutoTeams=Yes |checkbox2=No |role=Bot |issub1=No |istrainee1=No |issub2=No |istrainee2=No |issub3=No |istrainee3=No |issub4=No |istrainee4=No |issub5=No |istrainee5=No |checkbox3=No |stream=https://www.twitch.tv/yeon7lol |twitter=Yeon7lol |instagram=yeon7lol |lolpros=https://lolpros.gg/player/yeon |deeplol=https://www.deeplol.gg/pro/Yeon-Sean_Sung |dpmlol=https://dpm.lol/pro/Yeon |checkboxSuppressOrgNavbox=No |checkboxSBS=Yes |checkboxTOCR=No |checkbox-res=No |checkboxIsSub=No |checkboxPrev=No }} == Biography == Yeon was born in Los Angeles, California. He began playing ''League of Legends'' in 2014, when he was 13. In the middle of 2020, he joined [[100 Thieves Next]] to replace [[Auto]], who was role swapping to support. Alongside star prospects like [[Tenacity]] and [[Kenvi]], Yeon dominated the North American amateur circuit and earned a spot at [[NASG 2020]], where he was drafted onto [[Team Ocean Drake (NASG Team)|Team Ocean Drake]]. His team won the event. Afterward, Yeon joined [[Team Liquid Academy]]. He would remain on the team for the next two years, winning LCS Proving Grounds twice in 2022. === 2023 Season === After dominating the academy scene for the past year, Yeon was promoted to be the starting bot laner for [[Team Liquid]] as part of a fully Korean-speaking roster. == Trivia == * His ID '''Yeon''' is based on his Korean name Sung Yeon-ho. * Was extensively mentored by [[CoreJJ]] while on [[Team Liquid Academy]] before being promoted to the LCS roster. * Speaks English and Korean. * His favorite pro players are [[Viper (Park Do-hyeon)|Viper]] and [[Ruler]]. * Likes anime and manga, also likes '''[[wikipedia:en:The King's Avatar (2017 web series)|The King's Avatar]],''' which is the origin of his previous ID '''Aki no Ki''' === Individual Awards === * LCS Rookie of the Year (2023) * LCS First All-Pro Team (2024 Summer) * LTA Finals MVP (2025 Split 1) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} === Images === {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
